cases.refreshed: Get free one-on-one support with everyday tech questions. Offered in English or Tiếng Việt. Our Tech Mentor assistance includes, but is not limited to, basic smartphone, tablet, and computer help; setting up and using email; downloading and using apps; making video calls (Zoom, FaceTime, Google Meet, etc.); browsing the internet (search engine basics, making simple searches, etc.); navigating the SJPL website and digital resources. Please note: Tech Mentor support is limited to basic technology questions. *Drop-ins are accepted. Appointments are recommended. To make an appointment, please call the branch at (408) 808-3033 or email Jin Luong at jin.luong@sjlibrary.org. Priority will be given to patrons with appointments.

cases.refreshed: Join our teen service group and earn community service credit, supporting the community by assisting with book displays, presenting children's programs, running book sales and more. Learn about teen volunteer opportunities by attending our monthly meetings - every Second Friday of each month. Teens Reach is the youth council for the San José Public Library, providing a key way for young adults to build their leadership skills by developing and participating in library activities, as well as becoming library advisors and advocates. If you are new to volunteering with San Jose Public Library, please check out Teens Reach: Community Service for more information. If you wish to apply, click "Sign Me Up" under Almaden Branch Library

cases.refreshed: Join us and learn all about Kinder Readiness! Children ages 3-5 will build early literacy skills as we explore different themes and hands on activities. For children ages 3-5 and their parents and caregivers. Space is limited. No registration required. Generously sponsored by the Friends of Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.

cases.refreshed: Join us to create your own pop art image. We will be using iPads, Apple pencils, the Sketchbook app and Keynote. Explore different features across these apps to learn fundamentals for photo editing. Transforming ordinary objects, such as figurines and erasers, allows participants to find artistic and scientific beauty in the world around them. Recommended for ages 8 and up. No experience required.
